en.shortDescription: Neon WebSocket proxy with PostgreSQL for serverless drivers
en.longDescription:
Runs PostgreSQL with Neon's wsproxy so apps using @neondatabase/serverless can connect locally.

WebSocket proxy on SERVICE_PORT_NEON_WS_PROXY (80). Postgres credentials use SERVICE_USER_NEONPG and SERVICE_PASSWORD_NEONPG.
